dedupe_keys.name: ptv visum macroscopic transport planning software

description: PTV Visum is commercial software for macroscopic modelling of transport networks and transport demand, public transport planning and the development of transport strategies. It builds transport models for long-term strategic planning and short-term operational use, with scenario management for infrastructure developments, new transit lines, population forecasts and zoning policies evaluated in batch runs, and detailed public transport network and service planning for buses, trams, metros, taxis and trains. PTV Group also sells Validate, a national traffic model for Germany updated since 2005 and calibrated with current counts, and for France since 2019. The software is generic and applied worldwide. It is available under commercial licence, with a free trial and a student version. Caveats: it is proprietary and paid, and model quality depends on the demand, network and count data supplied. Visum supports network flow assignment, capacity and investment planning of road and public transport networks and disruption scenarios such as construction site traffic. It complements PTV Vissim for microsimulation and the MATSim and OpenTripPlanner tools catalogued here.
